an3.127:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an3.127:1.2: Atha kho Hatthako devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā
an3.127:1.3: Bhagavato purato ṭhassāmī ti osīdati c' eva saṃsīdati c' eva na sakkoti saṇṭhātuṃ.
an3.127:1.4: Seyyathāpi nāma sappi vā telaṃ vā vālikāya āsittaṃ osīdati saṃsīdati na saṇṭhāti,
an3.127:1.6: Bhagavato purato ṭhassāmī ti osīdati c' eva saṃsīdati c' eva na sakkoti saṇṭhātuṃ. 2.
an3.127:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Hatthakaṃ devaputtaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.127:2.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho Hatthako devaputto Bhagavato paṭissutvā oḷārikaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinimminitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
an3.127:2.4: Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Hatthakaṃ devaputtaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:
an3.127:3.1: Ye te Hatthaka dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa pavattino ahesuṃ api nu te te dhammā etarahi pavattino ti?
an3.127:3.2: Ye ca me bhante Bhagavā dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa pavattino ahesuṃ te ca me dhammā etarahi pavattino,
an3.127:3.3: ye ca me bhante dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa nappavattino ahesuṃ te ca me dhammā etarahi pavattino.
an3.127:3.4: Seyyathāpi bhante Bhagavā etarahi ākiṇṇo viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññāhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi,
an3.127:3.5: evam eva kho ahaṃ bhante ākiṇṇo viharāmi devaputtehi;
an3.127:3.6: dūrato pi bhante devaputtā āgacchanti Hatthakassa devaputtassa santike dhammaṃ sossāmā ti.
an3.127:3.7: Tiṇṇāhaṃ bhante dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāno kālakato.
an3.127:3.9: Bhagavato ahaṃ bhante dassanāya atitto appaṭivāno kālakato,
an3.127:3.11: saṅghassāhaṃ bhante upaṭṭhānassa atitto appaṭivāno kālakato.
an3.127:3.12: Imesaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāno kālakato ti.
